desc:
A student planner in Google Sheets for every class, deadline, exam and grade. Type your classes and your syllabus deadlines once at the start of the term. The planner shows what's due this week, counts down to every exam, works out your grade in each class, tells you the average you need on the rest to hit your target, and tracks your GPA and study time.

You get a PDF with links to your own Google Sheet: a blank copy and a filled-in example. Set it up on your laptop, then check it on your phone in the free Google Sheets app. Not for Excel or Numbers, and not a printable.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD: open the PDF, tap the link and press "Make a copy". Nothing is shipped.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Start Here: set up your term in about 20 minutes
• Setup: term dates, a weekly study goal, up to 10 classes with credits and a target grade, an editable grade scale, and past credits for your overall GPA
• This Week (made for your phone): classes today, what's due in the next 7 days with overdue first, exam countdown, study time against your goal, and your grades so far
• Assignments: room for 200, with due date, class, type, weight (% of the grade), score and status. Overdue in red, due soon in amber. Tick when it's handed in
• Grades: your grade so far in each class, letter, target, the average you need on the rest, a what-if box for your final grade, term GPA and overall GPA, and a check that your weights add up to 100%
• Schedule: type each class time once and your week grid fills itself in, one colour per class. Labs, office hours and work shifts too
• Study Log: one line each time you study, in minutes
• Dashboard (laptop, one screen): pick one class or all. Term week-by-week chart of work due and hours studied, study time by class, grades vs your target, key checks with status, what's coming up and what needs attention

WHY IT'S EASY
• Type a score as 42 out of 50, or just 84, and the grade fills in
• Exams count down by themselves
• "Next due" and "Add" links jump to the right row, no scrolling
• Filter icons let you hide finished work
• Works for high school, college and grad school. Change the grade scale to match yours

STUDYING WITH ADHD? Our ADHD Planner adds a brain dump and a daily list sorted by your energy. Search KovaStudioHQ on Etsy.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the PDF after purchase
2. Tap the link and press "Make a copy"
3. Add your classes, class times and deadlines

GOOD TO KNOW
• The photos show example data. Your blank copy starts empty
• It needs a free Google account. It does not work in Excel or Numbers
• It does not send reminders. It shows what's coming when you open it
• GPA and grades follow your grade scale and weights. Teachers may round or curve, so treat them as a guide
• Personal use only. Please don't share or resell the file or link
• Digital file, so no returns, but message us and we'll help with anything

Designed and built by Kova Studio. AI tools helped during the build.
